The per-rep purchase-order report no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6517). The change is the same filter the other purchase-order queries already use.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period still come out with 0, and the ordering is unchanged. I did not add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='DataStore*'`, which passed with no output. I didn't confirm that pattern matched any test classes, so treat that as a weak check.
